source_note: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变
english_source_note: Characteristic Polynomial Invariant Under Order Swap
callout_id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#5
statement_en: Let $P =\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix}$ and $Q =\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,1\end{pmatrix}$. Then $$PQ=\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix},\quad QP=\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,0\end{pmatrix}.$$ The characteristic polynomials of $PQ$ and $QP$ are both $x^2$. However, one minimal polynomial is $x^2$ and the other is $x$.
callout_body: 令矩阵$P =\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix},Q =\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,1\end{pmatrix}$于是$$PQ=\begin{pmatrix}0,1\\0,0\end{pmatrix},QP=\begin{pmatrix}0,0\\0,0\end{pmatrix}$$而$PQ,QP$的特征多项式都为$x^2$。然而极小多项式一个为$x^2$另一个为$x$
